newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Four bidders for Argentine electricity utility.
newsitem.headline: Four bidders for Argentine electricity utility.

text.p: Four consortia have pre-qualified in an international tender for the sale of Argentina's Empresa Jujena de Energia, a company official said Friday.
Maria Amelia, a spokeswoman at Empresa Jujena de Energia, said the four groups are Electrica de Inversiones SA, Compania Electrica de Jujuy SA, Exteca Inversiones and International Electric Holdings.

Chile's Compania General de Electricidad is the operating company of Electrica de Inversiones SA, Spain's Iberdrola Investment Sociedad Unepessoal SA operates Compania Electrica de Jujuy and HEWAG of Germany heads Exteca Inversiones.
The winner of the tender will be announced on October 31, when the financial details of the bids will be presented.
